title: Worker denial evidence — sandbox prevents template/key/model access
summary: Escape tests prove the sandboxed worker cannot open template, key, or model files, cannot open sockets, cannot connect, cannot exec, and cannot fork — even though it shares the daemon's UID (namtor) which has read access to /var/lib/namtor.
mechanism: seccomp denies open/openat with EPERM before the kernel resolves the path, so the test works even when the paths do not exist on the CI host
